turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello Adrian Lim, this is Rachel Tan. Thank you for making time for our telephone discussion. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, office quite quiet now. Family gathering over the weekend kept me busy lah, but today I have some space to talk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I hope you enjoyed catching up with everyone. Did you manage to spend some time away from work?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Managed to leave the phone alone for a while. Quite rare these days. Got relatives visiting, so we all stayed around after lunch. The children didn't want to leave already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a pleasant break. I will keep our discussion focused and leave room for any practical questions along the way.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Can. Let me get the administrative details out of the way first lah. My FIN is F six three zero zero seven one five C. My date of birth is 2 June 1976.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: To confirm, your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, using money you do not need for near-term expenses. With Meridian Asia Equity Fund, a downturn in Asian equity markets could reduce the value of the underlying shares and therefore the value of your investment. Do you understand how a downturn in those markets could affect the fund and your investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Asian markets go down, the shares held by the fund can fall, so my investment value can drop also. Just making a note here ah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your long-term growth objective?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses for potential long-term growth. The fluctuations I can tolerate. My notebook quite messy today. Let me find a clear page first lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Meridian Asia Equity Fund because its Asian equity exposure supports your long-term growth objective, and its pooled structure means you do not have to select and monitor individual companies yourself. I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive returns in the future.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me gather my notes first ah. Easier when everything in front of me, instead of flipping around while we're talking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course. There is no need to hurry. I am here while you get organised.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Doing this by phone quite convenient actually. If I have to leave the office, the whole afternoon gets broken up. Here at least got my papers nearby, and no travelling back and forth.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: It avoids the journey, certainly. If you need to send any documents afterwards, please use our usual secure channel rather than ordinary email.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Found the page already. For this investment, I'll go with Meridian Asia Equity Fund. For the direction, I want to— Let me start again, I want to buy, lah. This is a fresh investment. Use Singapore dollars for the transaction. The amount I want to invest is 250,000. For the quantity, make it 1,500 units. Place it as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction to buy 1,500 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 250,000 in Singapore dollars. Is that your final instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Go ahead with the transaction as you just stated. After this, back to work already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to your afternoon. Please contact me through the usual channel if you have any administrative questions.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel Tan. This timing worked out quite well lah. Enjoy the rest of your day.
